conventions.rings: instantaneous cylindrical selections in fitted global plane; not tracked cohorts

conventions.oddModes: antipodal initialization suppresses odd modes; pair correlations retained in null reference

conventions.massQuantiles: inverse empirical mass CDF; no rank interpolation
conventions.potential: not evaluated; provide current specificPotential explicitly
conventions.virial: force virial not evaluated; provide current accelerations explicitly
conventions.overflowBins: upper=null includes all radii above the last edge; density is undefined there
conventions.cylindricalAxis: R=0 particles omitted from cylindrical velocity moments only

directSummary.scope: sampled instants only; conservation does not establish structural equilibrium

effectiveDirectSummary.scope: sampled instants only; conservation does not establish structural equilibrium

denseEnergySummary.scope: sampled instants only; conservation does not establish structural equilibrium

denseEnergyHamiltonian: Nominal G and epsilon; actual rounded GPU state/masses. Effective-parameter direct Hamiltonian measured separately only at saved full states.

stateComparison.definition: vectorRms=sqrt(sum_i |qGPU_i-qCPU_i|^2/N); relativeVectorRms=sqrt(sum_i |difference|^2/sum_i |qCPU_i|^2); particles retain identical source order.
stateComparison.qualification: Initial difference measures Float32 upload quantization. Final difference combines different rounded initial states, masses/constants and accumulated GPU force/integration roundoff. It does not isolate trajectory precision at identical rounded initial states.

qualification: New completed v1.0.1 GPU Float32 integration; analysis itself performs no additional integration and never changes the preserved run.
Float64 direct diagnostics evaluate the actual rounded GPU state and masses. They do not upgrade its trajectory precision.

Nominal and effective coefficient Hamiltonians are distinguished: GPU uniforms round G, epsilon-squared and dt to Float32. Rounded per-operation force/integration arithmetic does not exactly follow either analytic Hamiltonian.

Sparse direct maxima are lower bounds on the maximum between saved full states. N=1000 additionally has direct energy at every GPU step in denseEnergySummary; larger-N dense diagnostics remain approximate.
Thin/thick structural measurements include independent fitted planes and radial rings; energy conservation alone does not establish structural equilibrium.
